claims: The 2026 Masters cut rule dictates that only the top 50 players and ties after 36 holes (Friday) advance to the weekend rounds.
The previous rule included any player within 10 strokes of the leader.
The previous rule is no longer in effect.
For the 2026 tournament, the projected cut is approximately +3 to +5 after tough first-round scoring.
There were strong winds and tough conditions on Thursday.
The cut is expected to be around 3-over to 5-over par.
Bryson DeChambeau, Jon Rahm, and Patrick Cantlay are among notable players in danger after Round 1.
